---
title: Static removal of nested content
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
  docx: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ["MKKEEPINNERA", "MKKEEPINNERB", "MKKEEPSECTION", "MKKEEPSUB", "MKKEEPCALLOUT", "MKKEEPLAST"]
        - ["MKEXPERT", "veil", "group="]
    docx:
      ensureDocxRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ["MKEXPERT", "veil"]
---

## Kept section

Section text MKKEEPSECTION.

### Gone subsection {.veil group="expert"}

Subsection text MKEXPERTSUB.

### Kept subsection

Subsection text MKKEEPSUB.

## Expert section {.veil group="expert"}

::: {.veil group="advanced"}

Div text MKEXPERTWRAPPEDADVANCED.

:::

### Advanced header below {.veil group="advanced"}

Subsection text MKEXPERTWRAPPEDHEADER.

## Second expert section {.veil group="expert"}

Section text MKEXPERTADJACENT.

## Headers inside a Div

::: {.box}

### Inner kept

Text MKKEEPINNERA.

### Inner gone {.veil group="expert"}

Text MKEXPERTINNERSECTION.

### Inner after

Text MKKEEPINNERB.

:::

## Content inside other content

::: {.veil group="expert"}

Outer text with [a span MKEXPERTOUTERSPAN]{.veil group="advanced"}.

:::

::: {.callout-note}

Callout text MKKEEPCALLOUT.

::: {.veil group="expert"}

Div text MKEXPERTINCALLOUT.

:::

:::

Last text MKKEEPLAST.
